t: What Synthetic Enzymes for Plastic Degradation Is
title: What Synthetic Enzymes for Plastic Degradation Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Engineered enzymes eat plastic: PETases, cutinases, and designed proteins breaking PET, polyurethane, and other polymers into monomers for recycling — biology cleaning the plastic age. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Synthetic Enzymes for Plastic Degradation: start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.
key_points: Synthetic Enzymes for Plastic Degradation in one line: Engineered enzymes eat plastic: PETases, cutinases, and designed proteins breaking PET, polyurethane, and other polymers into monomers for recycling — biology cleaning the plastic age.
Why it matters: Enzymes recycle plastic infinitely at room temperature; no downcycling..
Where it is used: PET recycling, textile waste, microplastics, ocean cleanup..
Ladder rank 1 — the foundation. Everything else builds on this.
